# Project Control Center

Canonical public tracker repository: https://github.com/tsrnc2/project-control-center

Machine entry points:
- live state: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tsrnc2/project-control-center/live/state.json
- project registry: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tsrnc2/project-control-center/main/projects.json
- issues: https://api.github.com/repos/tsrnc2/project-control-center/issues
- agent protocol: https://github.com/tsrnc2/project-control-center/blob/main/AGENTS.md
- reviewer roles: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tsrnc2/project-control-center/main/reviewer-roles.json
- review request schema: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tsrnc2/project-control-center/main/schema/review-request.schema.json
- review protocol: https://github.com/tsrnc2/project-control-center/blob/main/docs/REVIEW-REQUESTS.md

Agents must read AGENTS.md before writes. GitHub Issues are human task/blocker/review-request threads; execution locks live on the live branch. Never publish private project evidence or credentials here.
